name: codecausality-monorepo
description: Local-first change impact intelligence for software repositories.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codecausality/core && npm run build -w @codecausality/cli && npm run build -w codecausality && npm run build -w @codecausality/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/core && npm run build -w @codecausality/core && npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/cli && npm run typecheck -w codecausality && npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @codecausality/core && npm run test -w @codecausality/mcp
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test -w @codecausality/mcp && npm run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm --filter @codecausality/core run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter @codecausality/core run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @codecausality/mcp run test && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.package:vsix: pnpm --filter @codecausality/core run build && pnpm --filter codecausality run package:vsix:pnpm
